description: Read this conversation with Kinro and get Kinro's new messages: the user's messages and Kinro's, oldest first, with each Kinro message you have not received before marked new. Show the user every new message as written, including links. Returns the latest 5 messages by default; set limit (up to 100) for more or fewer, and new messages are always included. When Kinro says it is still working, for example on a reply or a quote, set wait to true: the call returns as soon as a new message arrives, or after a short wait with a note that nothing is new. Messages you already received stay readable, so use it to recover a reply or quote you missed or lost. It sends nothing to Kinro.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id returned by ask_kinro. Reuse it for this conversation; omit on the first message. Never invent one or reuse another conversation's ID.

limit.description: How many of the latest messages to return. Default 5, at most 100.

wait.description: Set true to wait for Kinro's next message when nothing new has arrived yet, such as while Kinro works on a reply or prices a quote. The call returns as soon as a new message arrives.

name: get_kinro_messages

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id returned by ask_kinro. Reuse it for this conversation; omit on the first message. Never invent one or reuse another conversation's ID.

has_more.description: True when earlier messages exist. History is limited to the latest 100 messages; newly delivered messages are also included.

messages.description: The conversation's latest messages, oldest first.

from.description: Who sent it: the user (through you) or Kinro.

new.description: True for a Kinro message you have not received before. Show it to the user.

sent_at.description: When it was sent, in ISO 8601 UTC.

title: Get Kinro's messages
